risks: No page shows a folder-alone run of card-fixtures-checker, so its self-test status is unverified.
The recent bee-scouts commits shown are health and served-skill bookkeeping, so it is unconfirmed that the repo is shipping real work.
A similar earlier proposal (#111) was closed as superseded, so such run-log steps can be repeated without producing a committed result.
A self-test that passes only inside the original repo layout could fail when the folder is copied alone.
unknowns: Whether HivemindOS-Agents/bee-scouts is still shipping: None of its commits in the last 30 days is real work.
Whether the folder-alone self-test of card-fixtures-checker exited 0.: The committed SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md with the verbatim output and EXIT line.
Whether bee-scouts is still shipping real work.: Commits showing real work, not only health and served-skill entries.
wouldChangeMind: A committed SELFTEST_OUTPUT.md showing the verbatim folder-alone run ending EXIT=0 would support the checker.
A committed output showing a non-zero exit would show the self-test fails.
Real-work commits in bee-scouts would change the view of whether it is still shipping.
